children: Domain registrar's Q3 revenue missed analyst expectations
EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Total bookings for Q3 were $1.4 bln
GoDaddy expects FY26 revenue toward high end of $5.215 bln to $5.255 bln range, implying 6% growth at midpoint
FY26 NEBITDA margin target remains above 33%
Company reaffirms FY26 free cash flow target of about $1.8 bln, versus $1.6 bln in 2025
AIRO BOOKINGS TRACTION – Airo's annualized bookings run rate exceeded $100 mln and incrementally contributed to Q3 bookings growth
CUSTOMER BASE EXPANSION – Total customers reached 20.5 mln, up 40,000 during Q3, indicating broader platform reach
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 10 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GoDaddy Inc. is $100.00, about 6.1% below its October 28 closing price of $106.54
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
